info.name: Posit Connect API Reference API Keys Schedules API

items.docs:
Get the schedule change history for a piece of content.

Returns the current schedule (if any) and a list of historical changes
including when schedules were created, updated, or deleted.

Schedule data is returned in RFC 5545 (iCalendar) format.

A maximum of 100 history entries are returned, ordered by change time
(most recent first).

This action is permitted for content owners, users with collaborator
or editor rights, and administrators.
